headline: Google's AI Search Now Controls Your Apps—Starting with Instacart and Canva
reasoning: This topic scores highly due to its strong mainstream appeal, focusing on a major update to Google Search—a universally used product. It has immense practical value by showing users how to automate daily tasks, and its direct competition with ChatGPT provides a compelling narrative. The story is also highly versatile, easily adaptable into how-to guides, listicles, or comparison pieces, maximizing its content potential.
summary: Google has updated its AI Mode in search to allow direct integration with third-party apps like Instacart, Canva, and YouTube. Users can now perform tasks like adding items to a shopping cart or creating a music playlist directly from the conversational search interface.

source_articles.title: Google’s AI Mode now lets you link and interact with select apps
source_articles.excerpt: With this new update, Google is expanding AI Mode beyond answering questions and into completing tasks across the apps they use regularly.
